title: Privacy Policy
summary: This policy explains the basic information that may be submitted through this website and how it may be used to respond to project inquiries.
body:
## Information you provide
When you contact us, request an estimate or use an interactive website tool, you may provide information such as your name, phone number, email address, project details and photos.

## How information is used
Information submitted through the website may be used to respond to your inquiry, prepare for a project discussion, communicate with you and operate the website's contact or estimate tools.

## Service providers
Website forms and tools may use third-party service providers to transmit or process submissions. Their systems may have their own privacy and security practices.

## Public website
Do not submit passwords, financial account information or other highly sensitive information through ordinary website forms.

## Questions
For privacy questions relating to a website inquiry, contact Hammer Brick & Home using the contact information shown on this website.
seoDescription: Privacy information for Hammer Brick & Home website inquiries, estimate tools and contact forms.
